hunks.baseline: I opened my eyes as the System notifications appeared.
hunks.sol: I opened my eyes at the System notifications.

hunks.baseline: The first things to enter my view were the rippling branches below, swaying in the night wind, and the stars scattered across the blackened sky. Against my back, I felt the cold, hard touch of rock.
hunks.sol: The first things I saw were the waves of branches rippling far below in the night wind and the stars scattered across the pitch-black sky. Cold, hard rock pressed against my back.

hunks.baseline: I had expected as much. Even a preschooler could have guessed that Jeok Cheongang wouldn’t lay me down on a soft goose-down bed.
hunks.sol: I’d expected as much. Even a preschooler could have guessed that Jeok Cheongang wouldn’t lay me down on a soft goose-down bed.

hunks.baseline: *Then why does my body feel so heavy?*
hunks.sol: *Then why do I feel so heavy?*

hunks.baseline: Was it because I had been pushing myself too hard lately?
hunks.sol: Had I been pushing myself too hard lately?

hunks.baseline: Maybe it was because of the fifteen-day forced march. My body felt heavy, as if I had an iron ball hanging from me…
hunks.sol: Maybe it was the fifteen-day forced march. My body felt as heavy as if I had an iron ball hanging from it…

hunks.baseline: I turned my head toward the sound.
hunks.sol: I turned toward the sound.

hunks.baseline: I saw manacles fastened tightly around both hands and ankles, with chains connecting them to iron balls.
hunks.sol: Manacles had been fastened tightly around my wrists and ankles, with chains connecting each of them to an iron ball.

hunks.baseline: “…They’re really iron balls.”
hunks.sol: “…They really are iron balls.”

hunks.baseline: And why were these ridiculous things locked onto my limbs?
hunks.sol: And why were these ridiculous things locked around my limbs?

hunks.baseline: The answer came quickly. It was an easier problem than one plus one.
hunks.sol: The answer came quickly. It was an easier question than one plus one.

hunks.baseline: It was at that exact moment that I shouted the words like a thunderclap.
hunks.sol: The shout burst from me like a thunderclap.

hunks.baseline: “Look at this disrespectful little bastard.”
hunks.sol: “What an insolent little bastard.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had nailed me in the back of the head with a pebble, was approaching at a leisurely walk, his feet turned outward.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had nailed me in the back of the head with a pebble, ambled toward me with his feet splayed.

hunks.baseline: “How dare you toss around my epithet so casually in front of me? Am I your friend?”
hunks.sol: “How dare you throw around my epithet in my presence? Am I your friend?”

hunks.baseline: I had been rolling around on the rock in pain, but I sprang to my feet.
hunks.sol: I sprang to my feet after rolling across the rock in pain.

hunks.baseline: “That? Iron balls.”
hunks.sol: “That? An iron ball.”

hunks.baseline: “I wasn’t asking because I didn’t know what they were.”
hunks.sol: “I wasn’t asking because I didn’t know what it was.”

hunks.baseline: “Then why did you ask when you already knew?”
hunks.sol: “Then why ask when you already know?”

hunks.baseline: “From now on, these will be your arms and legs. They are training tools passed down through the Fire Gate Clan for generations, so treat them like your own children.”
hunks.sol: “From now on, these will be your hands and feet. They’re training tools passed down through the Fire Gate Clan for generations, so treat them like your own children.”

hunks.baseline: I was a virgin bachelor who had never even been in a relationship, let alone married, and he was talking about children?
hunks.sol: I was a virgin who had never even dated, let alone married, and he was telling me to treat them like my children?

hunks.baseline: Dumbfounded, I grabbed the chains attached to the iron balls and pulled.
hunks.sol: Dumbfounded, I grabbed one of the chains attached to the iron balls and pulled.

hunks.baseline: The sound of metal scraping filled the air, followed by a tremendous sense of weight.
hunks.sol: Metal scraped against rock, and I felt the tremendous weight behind it.

hunks.baseline: They were heavy enough that even a decent First Rate martial artist wouldn’t be able to stand still while wearing them.
hunks.sol: They were heavy enough that even a decent First Rate martial artist wouldn’t be able to remain standing while wearing them.

hunks.baseline: “These are training tools passed down through the sect for generations?”
hunks.sol: “These are training tools passed down through the clan for generations?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, of course, that’s not combined. Each one weighs two hundred geun.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, and that isn’t their combined weight. Each one weighs two hundred geun.”

hunks.baseline: With such monstrous objects fastened to all four of my limbs, their total weight was…
hunks.sol: With such monstrous things fastened to all four of my limbs, the total weight was…

hunks.baseline: I thought it over carefully before opening my mouth.
hunks.sol: I thought for a moment, then opened my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “……You really don’t hold anything back, do you?”
hunks.sol: “…You really will say anything, won’t you?”

hunks.baseline: I had expected to get hit for saying that, but for some reason, Jeok Cheongang’s reaction stopped there.
hunks.sol: I’d said it knowing I would probably get hit, but for some reason, that was the extent of Jeok Cheongang’s reaction.

hunks.baseline: “Regardless, you’ll live with those iron balls chained to you from now on. While training, of course, but also while sleeping and eating.”
hunks.sol: “Regardless, you’ll live with those iron balls chained to you from now on. During training, of course, but also while sleeping and eating.”

hunks.baseline: “This is all part of your training.”
hunks.sol: “It’s all part of your training.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang turned around without hesitation, so I hurriedly called out to him.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang turned away without hesitation, and I hurriedly called after him.

hunks.baseline: “W-wait a moment!”
hunks.sol: “W-wait!”

hunks.baseline: “No, but you can’t just leave before I’ve even answered.”
hunks.sol: “I haven’t even answered yet. You can’t just walk away.”

hunks.baseline: “So, what’s your answer?”
hunks.sol: “So what’s your answer?”

hunks.baseline: *Damn it. I’m having a serious internal conflict here.*
hunks.sol: *Damn it. This is a serious internal conflict.*

hunks.baseline: But once the initial shock of seeing the iron balls faded, my mind gradually settled.
hunks.sol: But once the initial shock of seeing the iron balls wore off, my mind gradually settled.

hunks.baseline: The world wasn’t easy. To receive a reward, you had to pay a corresponding price. That was true in the Murim and in the modern world.
hunks.sol: The world didn’t go easy on anyone. If you wanted a reward, you had to pay the price. That was true in both the Murim and the modern world.

hunks.baseline: Everyone—not just me—was living through a series of endless Quests.
hunks.sol: Everyone—not just me—lived through an endless series of Quests.

hunks.baseline: *If I were going to turn back over something like this, I wouldn’t have come all the way here.*
hunks.sol: *If this were enough to make me turn back, I never would’ve come this far.*

hunks.baseline: Compared to the fruits I would harvest in the future, this was a bargain.
hunks.sol: Compared to the fruit I would harvest in the future, this was a bargain.

hunks.baseline: After reaching my decision, I met Jeok Cheongang’s gaze.
hunks.sol: Having made my decision, I met Jeok Cheongang’s gaze.

hunks.baseline: “I didn’t hear you.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t hear you.”

hunks.baseline: He had acted as though he didn’t care either way, but I had known for a while that deep down, he wanted me.
hunks.sol: He had acted as if he didn’t care either way, but I had known all along that deep down, he wanted me too.

hunks.baseline: “You want to start right away?”
hunks.sol: “You want to begin right away?”

hunks.baseline: “They say you should strike while the iron is hot. If I’m going to do it anyway, it’s better to start now.”
hunks.sol: “They say to strike while the iron is hot. If I’m doing this anyway, I might as well start now.”

hunks.baseline: “You have a bold streak, I’ll give you that. But you need to eat first.”
hunks.sol: “You do have a bold streak. But first, you need to eat.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you think training means starving yourself? You need to have something in your stomach before you can accomplish anything worthwhile.”
hunks.sol: “Do you think training means starving yourself? You need something in your stomach before you can accomplish anything worthwhile.”

hunks.baseline: Under the faint moonlight, I peeled away the damp paper and found a fasting pill with a reddish cast.
hunks.sol: Under the faint moonlight, I peeled away the damp paper to reveal a fasting pill with a reddish cast.

hunks.baseline: “Stop complaining and eat it. It isn’t an ordinary fasting pill. It was made using a secret Fire Gate Clan method.”
hunks.sol: “Stop complaining and eat it. That isn’t an ordinary fasting pill. It was made using a secret Fire Gate Clan method.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s superior in every way, but…”
hunks.sol: “It’s superior in every respect, but…”

hunks.baseline: “This stuff makes my stomach feel so bloated. These days, just looking at one kills my appetite.”
hunks.sol: “This stuff makes my stomach feel so bloated. Just looking at it kills my appetite now.”

hunks.baseline: “Wow, my mouth’s watering just looking at it.”
hunks.sol: “Wow. My mouth’s watering just looking at it.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll enjoy the meal!”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for the meal!”

hunks.baseline: If it was good for virility, I had to eat it. Even if I had no immediate use for it, I had to eat it no matter what.
hunks.sol: If it was good for virility, I had to eat it. Even if I had no immediate use for it, I still had to eat it.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang watched me intently before asking,
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang watched me intently before asking, “Finished?”

hunks.baseline: “Did you finish it?”
“What, you don’t feel anything?”
hunks.sol: “Well? Feel anything?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang frowned at my answer and muttered,
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang frowned at my answer and muttered, “Strange. Has it been sitting around so long that the medicine lost its potency?”

hunks.baseline: “Strange. Perhaps the medicine lost its potency because it was made too long ago?”

hunks.baseline: What the hell was he talking about?
hunks.sol: What the hell did that mean?

hunks.baseline: I had just asked him that without thinking when—
hunks.sol: The moment I blurted out the question—

hunks.baseline: It happened without any warning.
hunks.sol: It happened without warning.

hunks.baseline: As soon as the System notification appeared, strength drained from my arms and legs, and my breathing grew short.
hunks.sol: The instant the System notification appeared, strength drained from my arms and legs, and my breathing grew short.

hunks.baseline: Finally, the internal energy that had been flowing steadily through the lesser meridians throughout my body descended into my dantian. Then it became completely immobile, as though bound by something.
hunks.sol: Finally, the internal energy flowing steadily through the minor meridians throughout my body descended into my dantian. Then it became completely immobile, as though something had bound it in place.

hunks.baseline: My strength vanished all at once, and the body that had somehow been supporting the weight of the iron balls sagged.
hunks.sol: With all my strength gone at once, my body, which had somehow been supporting the iron balls, sagged.

hunks.baseline: The half-ton weight pressing down on my entire body made my knees buckle.
hunks.sol: The half ton of weight bearing down on me made my knees buckle.

hunks.baseline: I stared at Jeok Cheongang, who was letting out a sinister laugh, with my jaw hanging open.
hunks.sol: My jaw dropped as I stared at Jeok Cheongang and his sinister grin.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s see… For your first training session, that seems like the best choice.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s see… Yes, that should do nicely for your first training exercise.”

hunks.baseline: As soon as he finished speaking, his wrinkled palm opened toward me.
hunks.sol: As soon as he finished speaking, he extended a wrinkled palm toward me.

hunks.baseline: An immense flow of qi filled the air. The wind that had been blowing fiercely changed direction and began to whirl around him.
hunks.sol: An immense flow of qi filled the air. The fierce wind abruptly changed direction and began swirling around him.

hunks.baseline: Then a flash of insight struck me.
hunks.sol: A flash of insight struck me.

hunks.baseline: *There’s a cliff below this, isn’t there?*
hunks.sol: *Isn’t there a cliff right behind me?*

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly looked behind me. The view below the rock was dizzying.
hunks.sol: I hurriedly glanced back. The view below the rock was dizzying.

hunks.baseline: If I fell from here with these insane iron balls attached to me…
hunks.sol: If I fell from here with these monstrous iron balls attached to me…

hunks.baseline: “W-wait a moment!”
hunks.sol: “W-wait!”

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, wait? Didn’t you say it was better to strike while the iron was hot?”
hunks.sol: “Wait for what? Weren’t you the one who said we should strike while the iron was hot?”

hunks.baseline: Compressed air burst from Jeok Cheongang’s palm. A blast of fist wind powerful enough to uproot rocks and trees transformed into the fist of a giant and hammered into me.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded from Jeok Cheongang’s palm. The blast of fist wind, powerful enough to uproot rocks and trees, became a giant’s fist and slammed into me.

hunks.baseline: “You have one shichen to get back up. If you’re even fifteen minutes late, you fail.”[^2]
hunks.sol: “You have one shichen to make it back up. If you’re even fifteen minutes late, you fail.”[^2]

hunks.baseline: “This is such bullsh—!”
hunks.sol: “This is fucking bullsh—!”

hunks.baseline: Before I could finish speaking, gravity bore down on my entire body.
hunks.sol: Before I could finish, gravity seized my entire body.

hunks.baseline: As I plummeted like a streak of light, there was only one thing I could say.
hunks.sol: As I plummeted like a streak of light, only one sound escaped me.

hunks.baseline: My terrified scream shook Mount Jiuhua, which lay submerged in darkness.
hunks.sol: My terrified scream shook Mount Jiuhua, submerged in darkness.

hunks.baseline: Far below the sheer cliff, Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh at the sound of water echoing up from below.
hunks.sol: Far below the sheer cliff, the sound of water echoed up from the darkness. Jeok Cheongang let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “I’m counting to three. Let go. Three.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll count to three. Let go. Three.”

hunks.baseline: His Master had been merciless—harsh enough to seem excessive when inflicted on a child whose baby fuzz had yet to disappear.
hunks.sol: His Master had been merciless—harsh enough to seem excessive toward a child who still had baby fuzz on his face.

hunks.baseline: But without such harsh instruction, neither the Fire Gate Clan of today nor Fire King Jeok Cheongang would exist.
hunks.sol: But without that brutal instruction, neither the Fire Gate Clan of today nor Fire King Jeok Cheongang would exist.

hunks.baseline: *I’ll put you through what I went through… No, I’ll push you a little harder.*
hunks.sol: *I’ll put you through exactly what I endured… No, I’ll push you even harder.*
They did not have much time.

hunks.baseline: There was no time to teach him everything gradually, one step at a time.
hunks.sol: Teaching him gradually, one step at a time, would take too long.

hunks.baseline: *Hold out until then. This old man will do his best, too.*
hunks.sol: *Hold out until then. This old man will do his best as well.*

hunks.baseline: After staring down the mountain for some time with a profound look in his eyes, Jeok Cheongang suddenly muttered,
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang gazed down the mountain for some time, his eyes unfathomably deep. Then he suddenly muttered, “…Perhaps I shouldn’t have put the iron balls on him.”

hunks.baseline: “…Perhaps I shouldn’t have put the iron balls on him.”
He had never imagined that the object meant to restrain criminals of the Fire Gate Clan would be used for something like this.
hunks.sol: He had never imagined that restraints meant to shackle criminals of the Fire Gate Clan would be used for something like this.

hunks.baseline: But I was already used to it. Sweating profusely, I continued climbing the steep mountain path.
hunks.sol: But I was used to it by now. Sweat poured off me as I continued up the steep mountain path.

hunks.baseline: “Huff. Huff.”
hunks.sol: “Huff, huff.”

hunks.baseline: Even a drizzle will soak you through eventually, so these stat increases, though small, helped more than you might think.
hunks.sol: A steady drizzle soaks you before you know it. These stat increases might have been small, but they helped more than one would expect.

hunks.baseline: If either one had been absent, I would have completed the Quest long ago.
hunks.sol: Without either one, I would have completed the Quest long ago.

hunks.baseline: But my most important internal energy was restricted, my physical stats had each dropped by 100, and the tremendous weight had been added on top of that. I had no way to endure it.
hunks.sol: But my most important internal energy had been sealed away, my physical stats had each fallen by 100, and a tremendous weight had been piled on top of that. It was almost unbearable.

hunks.baseline: *Shit, Mount Jiuhua isn’t some little hill behind the neighborhood.*
hunks.sol: *Shit. Mount Jiuhua isn’t some little hill behind the neighborhood.*

hunks.baseline: It was so difficult that I even considered breaking the chains connecting the iron balls.
hunks.sol: It was so grueling that I had even considered breaking the chains connecting the iron balls.

hunks.baseline: That was before I learned the chains were made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.
hunks.sol: That was before I learned they were made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.

hunks.baseline: *They used this for chains? Are they insane?*
hunks.sol: *They used this stuff for chains? Were they insane?*

hunks.baseline: In the end, I had no choice but to grit my teeth and power through.
hunks.sol: In the end, I had no choice but to keep going through sheer stubbornness and grit.

hunks.baseline: With about fifteen minutes remaining on the time limit, I finally reached the summit.
hunks.sol: With about fifteen minutes left before the deadline, I finally reached the summit.

hunks.baseline: I slammed the heavy iron weights onto the ground and let out a roar that rose from the depths of my lungs.
hunks.sol: I let the heavy iron balls crash to the ground and released a roar from the depths of my lungs.

hunks.baseline: The sound startled Jeok Cheongang, who had been nodding off against a rock. He sprang awake.
hunks.sol: The sound startled Jeok Cheongang, who had been nodding off against a rock. He jolted awake.

hunks.baseline: Grinding my teeth, I walked toward him.
hunks.sol: Grinding my teeth, I stalked toward him.

hunks.baseline: “Huh? Why are you climbing Mount Jiuhua?”
hunks.sol: “Huh? Why did you climb Mount Jiuhua?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang blinked, then hurriedly shook his head.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang blinked, then hastily shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, no. You did pretty well.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, never mind. You did fairly well.”

hunks.baseline: “I think we can move on to the next stage now. I’ve made the preparations, so handle it yourself.”
hunks.sol: “It seems you’re ready for the next stage. I’ve already made the preparations, so take care of it yourself.”

hunks.baseline: I turned my head toward where his finger was pointing.
hunks.sol: I turned toward where he was pointing.

hunks.baseline: Propped against a massive rock was a vest. A huge, incredibly thick vest made of iron.
hunks.sol: Propped against a massive rock was a vest—a huge, incredibly thick vest made of iron.

hunks.baseline: My fingertips began to tremble despite myself.
hunks.sol: My fingertips began to tremble.

hunks.baseline: “…Is this what I think it is?”
hunks.sol: “…Is that what I think it is?”

hunks.baseline: “What were you thinking?”
hunks.sol: “What do you think it is?”

hunks.baseline: “That I’m supposed to put this on and repeat exactly what I’ve been doing until now.”
hunks.sol: “You want me to put it on and repeat everything I’ve been doing.”

hunks.baseline: “Ha-ha. You had such a cute little imagination.”
hunks.sol: “Ha-ha. What an adorable imagination you have.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang let out an amiable laugh like a kindly old man from the neighborhood before continuing.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang chuckled with the amiable smile of a kindly neighborhood grandfather, then continued.

hunks.baseline: “If you manage one, the next step should be two or more. Now that I think about it, one shichen was far too generous.”
hunks.sol: “If you’ve managed one thing, you should accomplish at least two the next time. Come to think of it, one shichen was far too generous.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll give you half a shichen. Hurry up, pick it up, put it on, and get back here.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll give you half a shichen. Hurry up, put it on, and get going.”
